t.send_keystrokes('cat > /tmp/ht_cat2\n', wait_sec=1.0)

t.send_keystrokes('echo CAT2-DONE; cat /tmp/ht_cat2; echo END\n', wait_sec=1.0)
print(t.get_output()[-2000:])
t.close()
